items.reason: Describes the same undefined-rule ability leak that enables Duplicate on cloud rules using Grafana create permission.
Describes the lost federated-group check and hardcoded isFederated=false, which enables modification of federated Mimir rules.
Describes the same Duplicate permission leak when the Grafana ability hook receives undefined and its result is ORed with ruler abilities.
Describes the alerting-only check incorrectly disabling Grafana-managed actions for recording rules.
Describes the same recording-rule exclusion from Pause, Restore, DeletePermanently and ModifyExport caused by using alertingRule for their gates.
